subject: history
concept: Applying revolutions knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student writes a simple list of grievances and demands for an imagined group facing an unfair situation
exercise.abstract: Student explains why their listed grievances would likely lead to organized demand for change

assessment.mastery_threshold: grievances are specific and connected to a real, identifiable problem
misconception_flags: lists a vague grievance with no clear connection to a real problem or unfairness

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
